1. Declared three stopping rules upfront (best_so_far_above 1.0 → stop, failures_at_least 3 → stop, last_gain_at_most 0.02 → restart) and a weak simplicity-based prior before seeing any data.

6. Submitted the rule candidate **[33+, 35-]**.
